description: Tribal Climate Change Guide is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Pacific Northwest Tribal Climate Change Network; University of Oregon | Environmental Studies Program; USFS | Pacific Northwest Research Station. The Tribal Climate Change Guide is a searchable database that features information on available grants, adaptation plans, climate programs, and climate tools to assist Native peoples in addressing impacts of climate change on their communities and ways of life. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Critical Facilities, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
